description: This file defines the ReprocessLoanTransactionsService interface, which declares methods for reprocessing loan transactions in the loan accounting module.

classes.name: ReprocessLoanTransactionsService
classes.description: An interface defining contract methods for reprocessing loan transactions.

methods.name: reprocessTransactions
methods.description: Reprocess all transactions related to the provided loan.

methods.name: reprocessParticularTransactions
methods.description: Reprocess specific loan transactions provided in the list.

methods.name: reprocessTransactionsWithPostTransactionChecks
methods.description: Reprocess transactions on a given date with additional post-transaction checks.

methods.name: processPostDisbursementTransactions
methods.description: Handle post-disbursement processing for the loan.

methods.name: removeLoanCharge
methods.description: Remove a specific charge from the loan.

methods.name: processLatestTransaction
methods.description: Process the latest transaction for the loan.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Update the loan model with the latest state.
